summary: Host only; nothing flashed or run on the phone. loader-diag-trig-hold (NAT-020 build-003 loader through patch_loader.py --trig-hold, linked with markerlib.c -DMK_TRIG=1 -DMK_LOADER=1) builds reproducibly (two builds identical): loader Image 901565b225c2137ebd99e4684cb4dc9a6b4f3ecf68632eedcf9ef8b16cf7db28 (212992 B), Image.payload 7c6206bd06923a91524afe95ec03573ed6fa680978cc839c40991debf7702cb3 (21767776 B), packaged with the NAT-006 builder into RECOVERY image 511b4833f0b6c24f5adffe762451bcbf937aa9a23b64bdd41d254885e006c475 (19634 differing 4 KiB pages, kernel at offset 2048). All five build-003 images (canary-plain, canary-fault, canary-trig, canary-trig-fault, loader-diag) are byte-identical to build-003, including the two that ran. The variant stops at PRE_JUMP in mk_hold (noreturn) before the only 'return entry_pa;', so it never jumps into the kernel copy (source-level check; the linked instruction stream was not disassembled, no AArch64 disassembler on the host). 28 host tests pass (python3 -P docs/procedures/nat-022/test_nat022.py), including LoaderHold against the real markerlib.c and a fake DECON0: stage order and reached-stage mask, hold-loop frame set and exact frame count, no MMIO before the first marker, fail() codes (fnv16 of every fail message in loader.c, C against Python, no collisions), loader exception loop with ESR/ELR/FAR, and no MMIO with the MMU on or an interrupted kick. make check passed (214 tests; it does not include test_nat022.py). Static check of the objects: no absolute pointer other than the header _payload_start field; code and data use adr/adrp and the ui label tables are char arrays, so the loader needs no relocation at the 4 KiB-aligned 0x801a0000 where S-Boot ran the canary (inferred from run 003). Not shown by any host test: the AArch64 start path, the loader's real DTB/RAM use, RAM zero/copy/clean timing against the ~60 s display lifetime and the 83 s watchdog the loader arms, and DECON0 behaviour while the loader moves memory. session_loaderhold.py refuses to run unless docs/decisions/0012-nat022-loader-diag-trig-hold-single-run-2026-11-10.md exists; that decision is not made. The image-specific request is put to the owner in the session.
